description: This file manages Wi-Fi survey cache data, including sample collection, processing, and lifecycle management for different radio channels and survey types.

classes.name: sm_survey_t
classes.description: Represents a Wi-Fi survey record, including identification, samples, and scan data for on-channel and off-channel surveys.

classes.name: sm_survey_cache_t
classes.description: Manages cache of all survey entries, providing initialization, cleanup, and iteration over stored surveys.

classes.name: sm_survey_scan_t
classes.description: Contains scan data, including samples, old statistics, and update status for a given survey.

methods.name: void survey_samples_free(ds_dlist_t * samples)
methods.description: Frees the samples linked list in the given ds_dlist_t.

methods.name: int survey_id_get(const unsigned int radio_index,const unsigned int channel,sm_survey_id_t id)
methods.description: Generates a unique survey ID string based on radio index and channel.

methods.name: void survey_clean_by_survey_type(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,sm_survey_t * survey,survey_type_t survey_type)
methods.description: Resets scan data for a specific survey and type, marking it as not updated.

methods.name: void survey_free(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,sm_survey_t * survey)
methods.description: Removes and frees a survey record from cache, including its samples and old statistics.

methods.name: bool survey_ready_to_free(sm_survey_t * survey)
methods.description: Checks if a survey record is ready to be freed (i.e., no old stats remaining).

methods.name: void survey_free_by_survey_type(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,sm_survey_t * survey,survey_type_t survey_type)
methods.description: Frees scan data for a specific survey and survey type, freeing the survey if all data is cleared.

methods.name: sm_survey_t * survey_alloc(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,sm_survey_id_t survey_id)
methods.description: Creates a new survey record and initializes its data structures.

methods.name: sm_survey_t * survey_get_or_alloc(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,sm_survey_id_t survey_id)
methods.description: Retrieves a survey from cache or allocates a new one if it does not exist.

methods.name: void survery_result_extra_calc(survey_type_t survey_type,dpp_survey_record_t * result)
methods.description: Adjusts survey result data, particularly the channel self and busy metrics.

methods.name: int survey_convert_hal_to_sample(unsigned int radio_index,survey_type_t survey_type,radio_chan_data_t * old,radio_chan_data_t * new,dpp_survey_record_t * result)
methods.description: Converts HAL layer radio channel data into survey sample records, calculating percentages and timestamps.

methods.name: int survey_sample_add(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,survey_type_t survey_type,unsigned int radio_index,radio_chan_data_t * stats)
methods.description: Adds a new survey sample to cache, creating survey instances and scan data if needed.

methods.name: int sm_survey_sample_store(unsigned int radio_index,survey_type_t survey_type,radio_chan_data_t * stats)
methods.description: Public API to store a new survey sample for a specified radio and survey type.

methods.name: int sm_survey_samples_calc_average(ds_dlist_t * samples,dpp_survey_record_avg_t * result)
methods.description: Calculates average statistics over a list of survey samples.

methods.name: void sm_survey_cache_clean(sm_survey_cache_t * cache,survey_type_t survey_type)
methods.description: Cleans survey data for a specific survey type across all stored surveys.

methods.name: void sm_survey_cache_free_after_reconf(unsigned int radio_index,survey_type_t survey_type)
methods.description: Frees and cleans survey data after radio reconfiguration for a specific survey type.

methods.name: void sm_survey_cache_free(sm_survey_cache_t * cache)
methods.description: Frees all surveys in the cache.

methods.name: void sm_survey_cache_deinit(sm_survey_cache_t * cache)
methods.description: Deinitializes the survey cache and frees resources.

methods.name: sm_survey_scan_t * sm_survey_get_scan_data(sm_survey_t * survey,survey_type_t survey_type)
methods.description: Returns the scan data associated with a survey based on survey type.
